It fires when the noun is the third token or later and follows a determiner, quantifier or verb ('one time', 'in most cases', 'that night', 'just hours after', 'a month later', 'the following year'). The same words as the first or second token of a text ('Hours later', 'Soon afterward', 'Days later', 'Years ago'), a duration after 'for' ('for three weeks', 0.21), 'every hour' (0.46) and 'time' as a modifier ('The time machine') stay below 0.55; 'soon', 'shortly', 'just' and 'last year' are weak or borderline (0.4 to 0.9). Non-temporal words cross only in two cases: an intransitive motion or position verb plus a place phrase ('fell on the', 0.83 to 1.1; 'crossed the street', 0.69; 'fell on the floor', 0.79), and evaluative words for events (surreal, bizarre, tragic, abruptly, immediately). Plain transitive sentences about objects, people and places (sold, gave, built, wrote, fixed, painted, with no time, occasion or motion-to-place phrase) stay below the line.
